title: WorkArena: How Capable are Web Agents at Solving Common Knowledge Work Tasks?
abstract: We introduce WorkArena, a benchmark for evaluating the ability of web agents to perform common knowledge work tasks, and BrowserGym, a framework for designing and evaluating these agents. Our empirical evaluation reveals that while current agents show promise, there remains a significant gap towards achieving full task automation.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content: Imagine having a personal assistant that can help you with everyday tasks, like filling out forms or searching for information. This is the idea behind web agents, which can interact with websites on your behalf. But how capable are they at solving common knowledge work tasks? We introduce WorkArena, a benchmark to evaluate their abilities.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content: WorkArena consists of 33 tasks and 19,912 unique instances that cover core interactions with the ServiceNow platform. Each task is coupled with a natural language goal that provides instructions to the agent. The agent can interact with the website using a chat interface, and can perform actions such as clicking, typing, and navigating.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content: Our empirical evaluation reveals that while current agents show promise, there remains a significant gap towards achieving full task automation. The state-of-the-art agent achieves a score of 25.4% on WorkArena, with a significant performance disparity between open and closed-source LLMs.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content: The ability of web agents to solve common knowledge work tasks has significant implications for productivity and accessibility. By automating repetitive tasks, web agents can free up human workers to focus on more complex and creative tasks.

config.title: Impact of Web Agents on Productivity

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content: WorkArena introduces several key innovations, including a rich set of multimodal observations and a broader set of actions. BrowserGym provides a flexible platform for designing and evaluating web agents, and supports chat-based user interaction and augmented attributes.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content: WorkArena and BrowserGym are open-source and available for use. Try designing and evaluating your own web agents using our framework, and see how they perform on the WorkArena benchmark.
